description: This file implements utility functions for cryptographic operations within the ANSC framework, including key checks, parity correction, key derivation, byte manipulation, and UUID generation.

methods.name: BOOL AnscCryptoIsDesWeakKey(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hKey)
methods.description: Checks if the provided DES key is weak by comparing against known weak keys list.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoFixParity(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hKey,BOOL bOddParity)
methods.description: Adjusts key bytes to ensure correct odd parity as required by DES.

methods.name: BOOL AnscCryptoCheckParity(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hKey,BOOL bOddParity)
methods.description: Verifies if the key bytes have the correct parity.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoCorrectDesKey(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hKey)
methods.description: Ensures DES key correctness by fixing parity and checking for weak keys.

methods.name: UCHAR AnscCryptoReverseByte(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,UCHAR ucValue)
methods.description: Reverses the bit order in a byte.

methods.name: UCHAR AnscCryptoXorByte(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,UCHAR ucValue1,UCHAR ucValue2)
methods.description: Performs bitwise XOR operation on two bytes.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoMitDesStrToKey(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hString,ULONG ulStringLeng,ANSC_HANDLE hSalt,ULONG ulSaltLeng,ANSC_HANDLE hNewKey)
methods.description: Converts input string and salt into a DES key format, fixing parity.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoNFold(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pInString,ULONG ulInBitNum,ULONG ulOutBitNum,PUCHAR pOutString)
methods.description: Implements N-Fold algorithm to stretch input bits to desired output bits.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoRandomToKey(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG algorithm,PUCHAR pInString,ULONG ulInLength,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY hOutKey)
methods.description: Generates cryptographic keys from random input data for supported algorithms.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoMapEncTypeToKeySize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ULONG algorithm,PULONG pulKeySeedSize,PULONG pulKeyLength,PULONG pulKeyNumber,PULONG pulKeyRound,PULONG pulBlockSize,PULONG pIvLength)
methods.description: Maps encryption algorithm types to key sizes, block sizes, and IV lengths.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoDesRandomToKey(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pInString,ULONG ulInLength,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY hOutKey)
methods.description: Creates a DES key from a 7-byte random string, adjusting parity.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoDes3RandomToKey(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,PUCHAR pInString,ULONG ulInLength,PANSC_CRYPTO_KEY hOutKey)
methods.description: Creates a 3DES key from a 21-byte random string, adjusting parity.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoDeriveKey(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hBaseKey,ULONG EncryptAlgorithm,ANSC_HANDLE hConstant,ULONG ulConstantLeng,ANSC_HANDLE hNewKey)
methods.description: Derives a new key from a base key and constant, following specific cryptographic draft.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscCryptoDes3StringToKey(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hString,ULONG ulStringLeng,ANSC_HANDLE hSalt,ULONG ulSaltLeng,ANSC_HANDLE hConstant,ULONG ulConstantLeng,ANSC_HANDLE hNewKey)
methods.description: Generates a 3DES key from input string, salt, and constant, with folding and derivation.

methods.name: char * AnscCryptoGenerateUuid(PUCHAR pMacAddress,ULONG ulMacAddrSize)
methods.description: Generates a UUID string based on MAC address and current time.

methods.name: char * AnscCryptoGenerateUuid2(PUCHAR pMacAddress,ULONG ulMacAddrSize,ULONG ulUuidVersion)
methods.description: Generates a UUID string based on MAC address, version, and cryptographic hashes.
